decisions.diagnosis: Sensor fault: every detection on these days is logged at zero speed, and daily counts jump about tenfold in both directions at once.
decisions.evidence: Daily raw N/S 63/70, 62/64, 65/62 against 2-10 on the days either side; all 130 non-zero slots have median speed 0.0, while zero speeds turn up in only 8 slots across 2012-2021.

decisions.diagnosis: Same zero-speed false-detection fault as late September, with inflated counts in both directions.
decisions.evidence: Daily raw N/S 108/112, 24/27, 28/29, 54/54 against 3-11 on the days either side; all 148 non-zero slots have median speed 0.0.

decisions.diagnosis: The counter failed on 2022-11-08 and never recovered; what remains is scattered single counts, zero-speed detections and runs of zeros that the automatic fix did not catch.
decisions.evidence: From 2022-11-09 on, almost every day is 0. The counts left in 2023-04-18..20 and 2023-08-29..30 are all at zero speed. South keeps zero days at 96 valid slots for 2023-07-15..19 and 2023-08-31..09-15 (1 bike in 17 days, against about 10/day before).

decisions.diagnosis: The automatic fix set South missing from 2021-07-21 18:00 to 2021-07-24 10:30 but kept North's 0 and 1 on those days; North may have been partly down as well, or the days may really have been quiet in lockdown.
decisions.evidence: North logged 0 (warning) on 07-22 and 1 on 07-23 against about 7/day around them; North did record counts at 23:15 on 07-21 and 21:30 on 07-23, so its sensor was alive.

decisions.diagnosis: The counter stopped: zeros found by the former automatic zero-outage rule and kept by the reviewer.

summary: Site 94 has one Piezo counter (AN435NEC), so each direction is its own series. It carries 5-12 bikes a day per direction, and the automatic zero_outage fixes handle the outages in 2014, 2021-03 and the intermittent failures of 2021-08/09 well. Seven days in late Sep/early Oct 2022 are false detections, all logged at zero speed and about ten times normal, and the counter was dead from 2022-11-08 to the end; all of these are set to missing.
